# Fitbit Air

> Fitbit Air (repository: ARRIIIIIS/google-health-dashboard) is an open-source, local-first macOS desktop health widget built with Tauri 2, Rust, and React 18. It displays real-time Google Health API metrics, Fitbit battery status, 7-day trend charts, interactive desktop companions, AI health micro-coaching, and smart sedentary reminders in a borderless Liquid Glass window.

## Key Facts

- **Product Name**: Fitbit Air (v3.1.0)
- **Platform**: macOS (Apple Silicon `aarch64` primary; Tauri 2 + `NSVisualEffectView`)
- **Tech Stack**: Tauri 2, Rust (1.88+), React 18, Vite 5, Python 3 (`fetch_standalone.py`)
- **Data Sources**: Google Health / Fitness API (OAuth 2.0), `pairedDevices` battery telemetry, macOS HID idle & screen-lock detection
- **Privacy Model**: 100% local-first; credentials stored in `~/.google-health-mcp/`; local setup server protected by per-process `X-Setup-Token`
- **License**: MIT

## Core Source Files

- [Main Desktop Widget](src/App.jsx): Liquid Glass UI, 7-day glow trend chart, companion host, 30fps cursor gaze tracking
- [Tauri Rust Backend](src-tauri/src/main.rs): Window lifecycle, macOS tray menu, local setup wizard HTTP server, scheduler
- [Setup Wizard UI](src-tauri/resources/setup.html): 3-step browser configuration wizard (Google OAuth, AI tips, preferences & companion picker)
- [Health Data Collector](src-tauri/resources/fetch_standalone.py): Python collector for Google Health & Fitbit battery
